name: XX99 Mark II Headphones
description: The new XX99 Mark II headphones is the pinnacle of pristine audio. It redefines your premium headphone experience by reproducing the balanced sound and depth of the original recording.
features:
Featuring a genuine leather headband and ultra-soft memory foam earcups, the XX99 Mark II delivers extreme comfort for extended listening. The high-density drivers reduce harmonic distortion while providing broad, detailed soundscapes.

Included with high-end balanced cables and an hard-shell carrying case, these headphones are built to perform anywhere.

name: XX99 Mark I Headphones
description: As the gold standard for headphones, the classic XX99 Mark I offers detailed and accurate sound reproduction for audiophiles, mixing engineers, and casual listeners alike.
features:
As the gold standard of audio, the XX99 Mark I offers an unmatched listening experience. Featuring precision-tuned dynamic drivers, these headphones reproduce sound with stunning clarity, warm bass, and crystal-clear highs.

Built for professionals, the robust headband and premium ear cups allow for hours of fatigue-free listening whether you're in the studio or at home.

name: XX59 Headphones
description: Enjoy your audio almost anywhere – transformed by the pure sound and ergonomics of the compact XX59 headphones. Perfect for the versatile audio enthusiast.
features:
These headphones have been crafted from top-tier materials to ensure durable, long-lasting comfort. Lightweight construction combined with soft memory foam earcups ensures you can wear them comfortably for long listening sessions.

The XX59 features high-performance drivers that deliver rich, clear audio across all frequencies, making it ideal for everything from podcasts to immersive music listening.

name: ZX9 Speaker
description: Upgrade your sound system with the all new ZX9 active speaker. It's a bookshelf speaker system that offers truly wireless connectivity -- creating new possibilities for more pleasing and practical home audio setups.
features:
Connect high-resolution audio sources using Bluetooth or digital optical inputs. The ZX9 active speaker features specialized neodymium drivers and custom tuning to deliver profound bass along with pristine mid-range detail.

The premium wooden cabinet finish fits into any modern living space while dampening unwanted vibrations.

name: ZX7 Speaker
description: Stream high quality sound wirelessly with minimal loss. The ZX7 bookshelf speaker uses high-end audiophile components that deliver crisp, clear sound with great depth and immersion.
features:
Rechargeable and portable, the ZX7 speaker brings incredible sound to any environment. Crafted from real wood enclosure and tuned for acoustic clarity, it handles high volumes smoothly without distortion.

Connect seamlessly via Bluetooth or standard optical / AUX inputs to fill any room with rich stereo sound.

name: YX1 Wireless Earphones
description: Tailor your listening experience with bespoke dynamic drivers from the new YX1 Wireless Earphones. Enjoy high-fidelity sound and incredible bass with soft silicone ear-tips in a portable charging case.
features:
Experience unrivalled sound quality wherever you go with the YX1 Wireless Earphones. Designed for durability and comfort, these earphones are built to withstand the rigors of daily use while delivering exceptional audio performance. The ergonomic design ensures a secure fit, making them perfect for workouts or commuting.

Powered by advanced Bluetooth technology, the YX1 Earphones offer seamless connectivity and a extended battery life. Uncompromised audio precision means you hear every detail of your favorite tracks.
